title: Telemetry rollout playbook: client schema negotiation, staged transforms, and auditability
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Ship an operational playbook for migrating telemetry producers (SDK/CLI/API) to the new analytics schema while preserving observability and enabling safe rollbacks. This ticket coordinates a) client-side feature gates and API compatibility checks, b) server-side staged transforms and provenance tagging, and c) an auditable canary rollout with automated health checks and rollback criteria. The deliverable is a runbook plus automation scripts and a short e2e test harness.
background: We are introducing a richer event envelope and explicit field-level versioning in the analytics pipeline to support better attribution, per-customer PII controls, and downstream denormalization. Previous migrations surfaced two main risks: silent client incompatibility causing dropped fields, and loss of lineage during on-the-fly format transforms. This playbook aims to mitigate both by combining explicit schema negotiation, tokenized transform steps with provenance metadata, and a staged rollout matrix across SDK/CLI/API clients.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook doc published to Confluence with step-by-step migration procedures and rollback steps
SDKs expose a runtime feature flag and semantic version header (Telemetry-Schema: v2+delta) and fall back to v1 on server rejection within 200ms
CLI includes a validation command `redwood telemetry validate --schema v2` that reports missing/extra fields and example repro payloads
Gateway supports a 'transform-phase' header to perform transparent v1 <-> v2 on-the-fly transforms for canary cohorts
Canary pipeline created: 5% tenant traffic routed to v2 transforms, with automated alerting on field-loss > 0.1% or ingestion error rate delta > 0.05
Audit logs include event_provenance array and original_payload snapshot for all transformed events during rollout
Post-migration smoke tests and a test harness that replays 48 hours of synthetic traffic with 100% field parity checks
tasks: Define compatibility matrix and failure modes (eng + analytics)
Implement SDK runtime header and feature flag with local validation
Add CLI telemetry validator and helpful error messages for engineers
Extend gateway to accept transform-phase and route to staged transformer lambda
Implement provenance tagging: provenance_id, transform_steps, original_checksum
Create canary orchestration in Console: cohort creation, percent rollout, and automatic rollback hook
Write e2e replay harness and parity checker for pipeline QA
Document rollback playbook and run a dry-run with internal tenants
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Clients silently truncate new optional fields -> Mitigation: SDKs will include runtime validation and the CLI validator provides preflight checks for infra engineers
Risk: Transform correctness bugs introduce data drift -> Mitigation: add original_payload snapshot and checksum to audit logs; run automated parity checks in staging before increasing canary percent
Risk: Increased ingestion latency from on-the-fly transforms -> Mitigation: limit on-the-fly transforms to canary cohort and use async backfill pipeline for bulk migrations
Risk: Security/PII exposure in original_payload snapshots -> Mitigation: redact PII fields using the new privacy mask config before snapshotting and require security approval for retention settings
